content.text: At school, she was an enthusiastic athlete who participated in hockey and tennis, while also competing in events such as the 800m, cross-country, and pentathlon.
2025 sees the Island Games hosted by Orkney.
On Saturday, the games in Orkney were officially opened by the Princess Royal, who welcomed competitors from 24 distinct island communities as they made preparations for the week-long event.
Having lived in Orkney her entire life, she mentioned that the games had created a wonderful excitement in the area.
